reading:
The judges like Quote Board at Evening for its typesetting and for how fast a page can be read. Every lens praised the quote head: a condensed Archivo title, the page's figure in its section ink, and a stacked mono unit and change line ('Things to do 4 OPEN / 3 LATE', 'Status 6 WORKING / 7 OFF'). Type and system called it the most confident display system of round 13, and interaction (8.3) and usability (8.7) called it the fastest glance. They also liked the slate trays, the three Home board cells with a figure in each, the Ideas and To do registers with real column heads and a NOW divider, the one-line Filter chip, the one-line setup strip, the Status lamp banks with counts, the row afterglow (the only one that registered), and 0 small targets.

It finished #5 (7.76), not higher, because of costume and a few slips:
- Six of eight lenses asked to remove the numbered keycaps 1-9 and the '0' gear in the bar and the Alt-shortcut legend in the footer.
- Vera's last chat line was set at headline size (type, system, style, skeptic), and Chat barely changed.
- The yellow To do '4' sits next to amber 'was due', so amber does two jobs. The family section is amber too.
- The board figures sit far from their labels, at the far corner of each cell.
- Show and Filter are hidden in folds, and there is no one-tap Late key.
- The empty tray under To do on Home, Settings labels in mono caps, 20px bold row titles that compete with the page title, squat month rows, and a steel-only Status.
- Soul and feedback both said the phosphor thins out below the greeting: the figures are in section colours, not light, and the violet '12' reads off-period.

To win, it should keep the quote head as the app's standard and keep the board, and strip the trading-floor costume. It should give each colour one job, using more grounded, lower-chroma section inks, and bring the tube's light back where something is live: the greeting box, Vera's lines, the Status lamps and the one live figure per page. From the tour finals, it should take the devices that are already count-board native: Settled Light's household contents row, Waypoint's day-numeral rows, and Sill Line's three-ring setup strip. All of them are rebuilt in the quote head's own type.

briefs.name: Quote Board, Posted
briefs.hypothesis: The carried design already had the best head and the fastest glance in round 13. Its points were lost to costume (bar digits, the Alt footer, a headline-size chat line), to amber doing two jobs, to figures far from their labels, and to phosphor that faded below the greeting. Removing the costume and giving each colour one job answers six of eight lenses' first fix. Three tour devices then make the count board richer without changing the line: Settled Light's household contents row, which its skeptic said the main tournament should adopt; Waypoint's day-numeral rows; and Sill Line's three-ring setup strip, which type called the best one-glance setup. All three are already 'a figure read at a glance', so they read as native. Bringing back the original's light on the greeting box, on Vera's lines, on the Status lamps and on the one live figure per page answers soul and feedback and the owner's latest word. That should lift soul and feedback from about 7 toward 8, without costing type, interaction or usability, which are already near 8.5.
briefs.brief:
Start from r13-mut-3's files: x14a-a/palettes/r13-mut-3.json and x14a-a/variants/r13-mut-3/ (sheet.css, templates/_ui.html, base.html, home.html, ideas.html, plans.html, plans_month.html, tasks.html, status.html, settings.html, settings_section.html, idea.html). Add a chat.html override built from the app's own. Keep, recognisable at a glance: the slate trays (--surface #151b1e, --surface-2, --bar #0f1417), bone ink, the steel reverse 'here' key, the denim links, the page_head macro (condensed Archivo title, figure, stacked mono unit and change line) on every page, the three Home board cells, the Ideas and To do registers with column heads and the NOW divider, the Filter summary chip, the row afterglow (--row-wash with the 2px lit edge that decays), the radar tube on Ideas, and the spend tube with the lamp banks on Status.

COLOUR, one job per hue. All changes are in palettes/r13-mut-3.json tokens and in sheet.css where a literal hue appears.
- --todo becomes wheat #d6c290 (from #f7dc78), so the To do figure and its section edge never read as caution.
- --people becomes clay #cf9a7c (from #ffb850), for Family, Memory and You.
- --warn and amber #ffb850 then mean late, needs a look and setup only.
- --ideas becomes heather #b6a3d8 (from #b58cec, lower chroma; feedback called the violet 12 off-period).
- --plans becomes steel-cyan #80c6d6 (from #70dcf4).
- Kind inks stay but drop about 15% chroma. The restaurant kind takes clay, not amber, so the restaurant legend and icon stop sharing caution's hue.
- #6dff9c is the light only. It goes on the mark and its cursor, Send and every primary button, the lit key word, focus, lamps, the now lamp, the tubes, the 'here' LED in the bar, the greeting box while someone writes in it, Vera's newest line as it lands, and the ONE live figure per page (rule below).

THE QUOTE HEAD, kept and refined as the standard (_ui.html page_head, sheet.css .page-head, .quote, .legend).
- The title stays condensed Archivo at about 4rem.
- The legend's top line sits on the figure's cap height and its bottom line on the figure's baseline (align-self:stretch, display:grid with align-content:space-between, line-height 1).
- The legend is mono 12px tracked caps. Mono caps are used ONLY here and in register column heads, never inline in rows.
- The change line's leading triangle becomes a 7px lamp. It is lit #6dff9c with an E20 halo when the change is live (next plan, working), an amber ring when it is late, and a steel ring otherwise.
- New rule, 'one live figure per page': the figure that counts something lit or running is set in phosphor with E1's two-layer halo and a hot core, at the glow strength the kit gives the greeting word (Status's working count, Chat's figure below). Every other figure is in its section ink, matte.
- On load each figure plays the lineage's own arrival flash (L114): whitened in its ink with a bloom, settling over var(--afterglow) 1.2s. prefers-reduced-motion skips it.

BAR (base.html, sheet.css .bar, .key):
- One row of named keys with icons. Remove the visible digit keycaps and the '0' gear. Keep accesskey attributes in the markup.
- The current key keeps the steel reverse cell and gains a 6px #6dff9c LED in its top-right corner (L140, already this line's).
- The Settings key keeps the word 'Settings' at 1280px.
- At 1280px, Memory and Family drop to icon plus word at --fs-small if space is short. Every key stays 44px tall.

FOOTER: remove the 'Shortcuts: Alt…' legend line. Replace it with a <details class="keys-help"> whose summary is 'Keyboard' with a keyboard icon and a 44px target. It opens a small slate popover listing the access keys and the modifier per browser. The tagline and copyright lines are kept.

HOME (home.html):
1. The greeting stays as it is: the glass pool, Vera's screen and name with the date, the box, the starters, and the Next up tube with the radar on the right.
   - Title: 'Give Vera something to *plan*.' The span on 'plan' gets E1 with a hot core, and the full stop is outside the span, in bone. It sets on two lines at desktop (break before 'to'), condensed Archivo 600 at clamp(2.6rem,5vw,4rem), with leading 0.95.
   - The box takes Trued, Relit's light (graft 4 below).
   - On the phone the Next up tube drops below the starters and shrinks to its title and one line, so it stops running past the first screen.
2. The setup strip becomes Sill Line's three-ring strip (graft 3).
3. The board, three cells as now (Coming up, To do, Lately added), with these changes:
   - The cell heads become contents lines: the section label in sentence-case Archivo 600 at 1.25rem, a dotted leader, then the condensed figure at 2.5rem on the SAME baseline, in its section ink. This is Waypoint's label-leader-figure readout (graft 2), so the figure stops floating in the far corner.
   - The Coming up cell's rows become Waypoint's hop rows (graft 2).
   - The To do cell's due words are set in one face (sans 0.9375rem), amber only when late. Its tray collapses to its content: .board{align-items:start} and each .tile{grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr auto} with the foot link in flow, so no 90px empty tray.
   - The tape rows are 15px with tabular figures and 44px targets.
4. The kids' wishes strip and the lower links become the household row (graft 1).

IDEAS (ideas.html):
- The head stays 'Ideas 12 / IN ALL / LAST ADDED SUN 27 SEP' in heather.
- At ≥64rem the kinds unfold into a row of latched one-tap keys (All, Restaurants, Activity, Outing… each with its count in tabular figures). The Filter summary chip stays for words, status and who, and is the only control on the phone.
- Row titles are condensed Archivo 600 at 1.125rem (from bold 20px), so the page title keeps its lead. Kind words are sentence case at 0.875rem in their muted ink, not tracked caps.
- The '4 shown (up to 100).' line is set in the text face.
- Phone rows are two lines: title, then kind · drive · for.

TO DO (tasks.html):
- The head is 'Things to do 4 / OPEN / ▸3 LATE'. The figure is wheat. '3 late' is an amber link to the late filter.
- The Show fold is replaced by a latched key row: Open · Late 3 · Done · Cancelled · All (44px, steel reverse when on), with Late as Lit Manual's tasks.html has it.
- Every row is the same size: condensed 600 at 1.125rem. Late due dates are amber, and late rows keep the 2px amber left edge. No row is set as a headline.
- The NOW divider stays with its lamp.

PLANS (plans.html, plans_month.html):
- The head is 'October 2026 4 / AHEAD IN VIEW / ▸NEXT SUN 4 OCT 13:00' in steel-cyan.
- The list view's rows become hop rows: day numeral, stacked month and weekday, time, name, when.
- In the month, cells are min-height 6.5rem, plan names are 0.875rem sans 500 with the time in mono 0.75rem above, today's cell has the steel reverse numeral with a lit lamp, and past days step back to --dim.

CHAT (chat.html, new override):
- The head is the quote device: 'Vera', then a figure, the count of her replies today, set in phosphor as the page's live figure with E1, then the legend 'REPLIES TODAY / ▸LAST 19:53'.
- Every line is body size (1.0625rem/1.5). The large last line is gone.
- Vera's bubbles are green-black glass (--bubble #111712) with a 1px #6dff9c 30% edge and her screen glyphs (presence) at the bubble's top-left at 2.25rem. The family's bubbles are slate (--bubble-them) on the right with the speaker's initial key.
- Her newest bubble, the #latest :target, flashes as L233's 'arrived' afterglow: border #6dff9c and a wide halo fading over 1.8s.

STATUS (status.html):
- The head figure '6 WORKING / ▸7 OFF' becomes the page's lit live figure, phosphor with E1.
- In the three lamp banks, each bank's count is set in its owner's ink: answers in phosphor, keys in steel-cyan, links in heather. Any 'needs a look' count is an amber figure.
- A key or fallback that is missing is a steel ring with the words 'none set', never a grey dot.
- The spend tube stays.

SETTINGS (settings.html, settings_section.html):
- The head is 'Settings 9 / PARTS / ▸1 NEEDS A LOOK' (amber change line when there is one).
- The 0·1-0·9 numbering stays on the cards as a small mono index, the one place digits remain. Field labels are sentence-case sans 0.8125rem/500, not mono caps.
- The household row is not repeated here.

PHONE: one column. The tab bar is as today's. Heads keep the figure beside the title (title 2.5rem, figure 2.5rem, legend under it on one line if it wraps). Every target is at least 44px.
briefs.borrows:
OWN JUDGES' FIXES, most-cited first:
(1) Drop the bar's digit keycaps and the Alt footer legend, keeping access keys in a 'Keyboard' help popover. Asked by system, interaction, skeptic, style, type and usability.
(2) Set Vera's last chat line at body size, put the quote in Chat's head ('Vera N · last 19:53'), and give Chat its own device. Asked by type, system, style, skeptic and soul.
(3) Give To do a hue other than caution amber (wheat). Asked by system, usability and skeptic. Family takes clay so amber means late or setup only, which is the designer's own named weakness.
(4) Set each board figure on its label's baseline. Asked by system and skeptic ('figures far from their labels').
(5) Turn Show and Filter folds into one-tap keys, with Late among them and kinds unfolded at desktop. Asked by usability and interaction.
(6) Collapse the To do cell's empty tray. Asked by style and interaction.
(7) Give Status colour beyond steel: bank counts in owner inks and an amber needs-a-look figure. Asked by style.
(8) Type fixes: row titles condensed 600 at 18px, Settings labels sentence-case sans 13px/500, the shown-count line in the text face, the legend aligned to cap height and baseline, and the tape at 15px tabular. Asked by type and style.
(9) Keep 'Settings' as a word at 1280. Asked by interaction and usability.
(10) Taller month rows with 14px plan names. Asked by usability.
(11) Phosphor back below the greeting: one lit live figure per page, Vera's lit glass and arrival flash, lit LED on the current key. Asked by soul and feedback.
(12) A missing fallback as a ring, not a grey dot. Asked by interaction; made a steel ring per the four-signal rule.

FROM THE OTHER CAMP:
1. Settled Light's household contents row, from Switchboard, Settled Light (t3-switchboard-refine). Its skeptic said 'keep the sommaire foot row, which the main tournament should adopt'.
- Files: x14a-a/variants/t3-switchboard-refine/templates/home.html lines 230-290 (section.household with .hh cells), templates/_ui.html contents_line macro at line 94 (slot lamp, name, dots leader, count and unit), and sheet.css .household rules around lines 937-948, 2476-2478 and 2781-2786. Shot: x14a-a/out/t3-switchboard-refine/shots/home.png.
- Rebuilt here as a full-width slate tray under the board, five cells across at ≥64rem (two at ≥40rem): Wishes · 0 open (Maya 0 · Theo 0), Memory → (Tell Vera something), Family · 4 people (Sam · Alex · Maya · Theo), Status · 6 of 13 on (lamps for anything off or looking), Settings · 9 parts.
- Each head is the quote head in miniature: sentence-case Archivo 600 at 1.125rem, a dotted leader, and the condensed figure at 1.75rem in the section's ink (wishes rose, people clay, status phosphor-lit only if all is working, else steel with an amber figure for needs a look). A 15px sub-line goes beneath.
- The 2px top cap is in the section ink. It replaces the standalone kids' wishes strip and the footer legend.

2. Waypoint Lamps' readout device, label · leader · right-hand figure on one baseline, and its Coming up hop rows with a big day numeral and stacked month and weekday, from t3-console-graft.
- Files: x14a-b/variants/t3-console-graft/templates/_ui.html rail macro at line 84, home.html lines 42-47 (cells) and 180-196 (ol.hops, li.hop with .hop-day, .hop-stack, .hop-mon, .hop-dow, .hop-time, .hop-what, .hop-rel), and sheet.css .rail lines 310-357 and .hop lines 770-793. Shot: x14a-b/out/t3-console-graft/shots/home.png.
- Rebuilt here as the board cells' heads (label, leader, figure on its baseline). In Coming up and the Plans list, each row leads with its day numeral in condensed Archivo 300 at 2.25rem, tabular, in bone, with the month in steel-cyan 600 and the weekday in --dim stacked at 0.75rem, then the time in mono 0.875rem, then the name in Archivo 600. The first row's day numeral and a 'Next' word take phosphor with a lamp.
- This replaces the carried design's single date leaf plus mono date tapes, so every plan reads at a glance in one style, which is principle 2's 'one mark joins a figure to its list'.

3. Sill Line, Ticked's setup strip, from t3-track-graft.
- Files: x14a-b/variants/t3-track-graft/templates/home.html lines 123-131 (section.setup-strip, ol.setup-track with li.next-step, .buffer, a.all-steps, a.setup-next) and the matching .setup-strip and .setup-track rules in its sheet.css. Shot: x14a-b/out/t3-track-graft/shots/home.png.
- Rebuilt in the quote idiom: a warning lamp, 'Finish setting up', then the amber condensed figure '3' as the strip's quote, then three 44px numbered rings joined by a 2px steel line, each a link. The first ring is lit amber with a halo, the others are steel rings. Then 'All 3 steps' and, at the right, 'Next: choose your own password →' as the one bold link.
- This answers system ('show all three steps') and interaction ('name the first step') at once, at 64px tall.

4. Trued, Relit's lit greeting box, from t3-track-refine2.
- Files: x14a-a/variants/t3-track-refine2/templates/home.html lines 24-80 (section.welcome, .welcome-words), templates/_ask.html, and the .welcome and box-glow rules in its sheet.css. Shot: x14a-a/out/t3-track-refine2/shots/home.png.
- Rebuilt on this line's existing glass pool: E7's pool gains a 1-in-3 raster at 4% opacity. The box rests in a faint E4 halo (0 0 0 1px rgb(109 255 156/.18), 0 10px 30px -14px rgb(109 255 156/.35)) and turns a full #6dff9c edge with E4's bloom while someone writes, via .ask:focus-within and .ask:has(textarea:not(:placeholder-shown)). Nothing glows inside the box until then.
- The lit title word takes E1 with a hot core.

LEDGER, one more: L233 'Arrived' afterglow on her newest reply (r10-mut-5 Signal Legend Relit). Her newest bubble's border flashes phosphor and fades over 1.8s. It gives Chat a phosphor moment now that her last line is body size.
briefs.avoids:
It answers each criticism in the dossier:
- Costume ('trading-floor costume', 'busy numbered bar', 'Alt footer clutter'): the digits, the '0' gear and the shortcut legend are gone. The keys live in a Keyboard popover.
- 'Vera's last line at headline size' and 'Chat barely changed': every line is body size, the quote moves into Chat's head, and her bubbles get lit glass and the arrival flash.
- 'Yellow To do 4 beside amber was due' and 'amber with two jobs': To do is wheat, Family is clay, and the restaurant kind takes clay. Amber means late, needs a look and setup only.
- 'Board figures far from their labels': each figure now sits on a leader on the label's baseline.
- 'Setup folded to one visible step': three rings with the next step named.
- 'Filters behind folds': latched key rows for To do (with Late) and Ideas kinds at desktop.
- 'Empty To do tray': the cells collapse to their content.
- 'Status monochrome': owner inks and an amber needs-a-look figure.
- 'Settings labels mono caps' and '20px bold row titles': sentence-case sans labels and condensed 600 at 18px rows.
- 'Squat month rows': 6.5rem cells with 14px names.
- 'Violet 12 off-period': lower-chroma heather.
- Soul's and feedback's 'phosphor thins below the greeting': one lit live figure per page, the LED on the current key, Vera's glass and flash, and the box lit while writing.
- The phone tube running past the first screen, and three-line phone Ideas rows: both cut.

What it gives up to make room:
- The numbered keys and their keyboard-first legend.
- The large quoted chat line.
- The single date leaf in Coming up.
- The standalone kids' wishes strip, folded into the household row.
- The mono date tapes on Home.
- Amber and lemon as section inks.
- The Settings key losing its word.
briefs.title:
'Give Vera something to *plan*.', with 'plan' lit (E1, hot core) and the full stop in bone outside the glow, set on two lines at desktop ('Give Vera something / to plan.').

It has not been tried. It replaces this line's 'What's on your mind?', which every title panel has failed as generic. It keeps what the panels rewarded in the best title so far, 'Tell Vera what to plan.' (8.02/8.01):
- It names who hears you.
- It is an invitation to type, not a request to be shown a plan.
- It lights the job word at the end of the line, where the eye stops.

It also mends the two faults judges found in its rivals:
- 'something' takes in a reminder, an idea kept for someday or a wish as readily as a dated plan, where 'our plans' and 'our plan' presume a plan exists.
- It cannot be answered 'no', unlike 'Anything to plan?'.

As a two-line display quote it suits a board that leads each section with one large line.
